title: Figure 8: Transactional interpretation diagrams for Case 1 (offer/confirmation waves)
description: Three stacked color diagrams of the slit-imaging system showing "Offer Waves," "Confirmation Waves" and "Completed Transaction" passing between switched detectors at slits S2, a "Nonlinear Crystal" with lenses, and slits S1 in front of a "Camera," with blue and red wave paths. The caption reads "Figure 8. Transactional Interpretation Diagrams for Case 1" and explains that offer waves pass through the upper slit of S2 to the circled upper detector, forming a one-slit transaction.
